pages.en: Animals live all around us.
pages.sourceText: Animals live all around us.
pages.zh: 动物就生活在我们周围。
pages.alt: 动物就生活在我们周围。
pages.tip: 一起找出画里的动物。

pages.en: Birds build their homes up high. And so do bees.
pages.sourceText: Birds build their homes up high. And so do bees.
pages.zh: 鸟儿把家建在高处，蜜蜂也是。
pages.alt: 鸟儿把家建在高处，蜜蜂也是。
pages.tip: 指指树上的鸟巢和蜂巢，说 high。

pages.en: Spiders spin their homes. Tiny termites build tall, tall homes.
pages.sourceText: Spiders spin their homes. Tiny termites build tall, tall homes.
pages.zh: 蜘蛛织出自己的家。小白蚁建起高高的家。
pages.alt: 蜘蛛织出自己的家。小白蚁建起高高的家。
pages.tip: 用手指描一描蛛网，再找找白蚁丘。

pages.en: Snails and tortoises grow homes on their backs.
pages.sourceText: Snails and tortoises grow homes on their backs.
pages.zh: 蜗牛和陆龟背上长着自己的家。
pages.alt: 蜗牛和陆龟背上长着自己的家。
pages.tip: 找找背上的壳；壳是身体的一部分，不能脱下来。

pages.en: Fish live in the water. Frogs can live in water and on land.
pages.sourceText: Fish live in the water. Frogs can live in water and on land.
pages.zh: 鱼住在水里。青蛙能在水里和陆地上生活。
pages.alt: 鱼住在水里。青蛙能在水里和陆地上生活。
pages.tip: 分别指指水里和岸上的青蛙。

pages.en: Rabbits and rats live in burrows under the ground.
pages.sourceText: Rabbits and rats live in burrows under the ground.
pages.zh: 兔子和老鼠住在地下的洞穴里。
pages.alt: 兔子和老鼠住在地下的洞穴里。
pages.tip: 沿着图中的通道找找小动物。

pages.en: Monkeys and apes make trees their homes.
pages.sourceText: Monkeys and apes make trees their homes.
pages.zh: 猴子和猿把树当作家。
pages.alt: 猴子和猿把树当作家。
pages.tip: 找找树枝上的猴子，轻轻说 trees。

pages.en: Bears and wolves live in dens.
pages.sourceText: Bears and wolves live in dens.
pages.zh: 熊和狼住在兽穴里。
pages.alt: 熊和狼住在兽穴里。
pages.tip: 指指洞口，再找找里面的动物。

pages.en: Crocodiles live in swamps.
pages.sourceText: Crocodiles live in swamps.
pages.zh: 鳄鱼住在沼泽里。
pages.alt: 鳄鱼住在沼泽里。
pages.tip: 观察水面和草丛，找找鳄鱼。

pages.en: Deer live in forests. And so do tigers!
pages.sourceText: Deer live in forests. And so do tigers!
pages.zh: 鹿住在森林里，老虎也是！
pages.alt: 鹿住在森林里，老虎也是！
pages.tip: 分别指指鹿和老虎，不必模仿捕猎。

pages.en: One Large Home Some animals live close to us and some live far away. But do you know what we have in common with all the animals of the world? We all build our homes in one large home: planet Earth!
pages.sourceText: One Large Home Some animals live close to us and some live far away. But do you know what we have in common with all the animals of the world? We all build our homes in one large home: planet Earth!
pages.zh: 有些动物离我们很近，有些很远。我们与世界上所有动物有什么共同点？一个大大的家：我们都生活在地球这个大家园里！
pages.alt: 有些动物离我们很近，有些很远。我们与世界上所有动物有什么共同点？一个大大的家：我们都生活在地球这个大家园里！
pages.tip: 用双手画一个圆，一起说 Earth。

activity.title: 读完去发现
activity.text: 去散步时找找鸟巢或蚂蚁的小洞，只观察，不触碰。

pages.en: Birds talk. And they talk a lot!
pages.sourceText: Birds talk. And they talk a lot!
pages.zh: 鸟儿会说话，而且说得可多啦！
pages.alt: 鸟儿会说话，而且说得可多啦！
pages.tip: 指指两只鸟，听听 birds。

pages.en: WAAAAHHHH! The Brahminy kite wails like a hungry baby. WAAAAHHHH!
pages.sourceText: WAAAAHHHH! The Brahminy kite wails like a hungry baby. WAAAAHHHH!
pages.zh: 哇——！栗鸢叫起来像饿了的小宝宝。哇——！
pages.alt: 哇——！栗鸢叫起来像饿了的小宝宝。哇——！
pages.tip: 轻轻模仿这个长长的声音。

pages.en: FHWEE! FHWEE! The Malabar whistling thrush whistles like a happy child. FHWEE! FHWEE!
pages.sourceText: FHWEE! FHWEE! The Malabar whistling thrush whistles like a happy child. FHWEE! FHWEE!
pages.zh: 咻咻！马拉巴啸鸫吹口哨，像个开心的孩子。咻咻！
pages.alt: 咻咻！马拉巴啸鸫吹口哨，像个开心的孩子。咻咻！
pages.tip: 不必会吹口哨，用嘴轻轻模仿就好。

pages.en: HU HU HU HU! HU HU HU HU! The laughing dove laughs as if it's being tickled. HU HU HU HU! HU HU HU HU!
pages.sourceText: HU HU HU HU! HU HU HU HU! The laughing dove laughs as if it's being tickled. HU HU HU HU! HU HU HU HU!
pages.zh: 呼呼呼！棕斑鸠笑起来像被挠痒痒了。呼呼呼！
pages.alt: 呼呼呼！棕斑鸠笑起来像被挠痒痒了。呼呼呼！
pages.tip: 和孩子一起笑一笑，感受这组拟声词。

pages.en: PUK! PUK! PUK! The coppersmith barbet sounds like a hammer striking metal. PUK! PUK! PUK!
pages.sourceText: PUK! PUK! PUK! The coppersmith barbet sounds like a hammer striking metal. PUK! PUK! PUK!
pages.zh: 扑克！赤胸拟啄木鸟叫起来像锤子敲金属。扑克！
pages.alt: 扑克！赤胸拟啄木鸟叫起来像锤子敲金属。扑克！
pages.tip: 在掌心轻轻点三下，跟着节奏听。

pages.en: WAAAAHHHH! FHWEE! HU HU! PUK! Who is that? That is the racket-tailed drongo who can copy other birds! WAAAAHHHH! FHWEE! HU HU! PUK!
pages.sourceText: WAAAAHHHH! FHWEE! HU HU! PUK! Who is that? That is the racket-tailed drongo who can copy other birds! WAAAAHHHH! FHWEE! HU HU! PUK!
pages.zh: 哇、咻咻、呼呼、扑克！是谁呢？是能模仿其他鸟儿的大盘尾！
pages.alt: 哇、咻咻、呼呼、扑克！是谁呢？是能模仿其他鸟儿的大盘尾！
pages.tip: 找找长尾巴的鸟，选一个叫声模仿。

pages.en: We may not know what birds are saying, But we know who is talking.
pages.sourceText: We may not know what birds are saying, But we know who is talking.
pages.zh: 我们可能不知道鸟儿说什么，但知道是谁在说话。
pages.alt: 我们可能不知道鸟儿说什么，但知道是谁在说话。
pages.tip: 请孩子指一只最喜欢的鸟。

activity.title: 读完去发现
activity.text: 在窗边安静听一会儿鸟叫，试着模仿一个声音。

pages.en: Hello, I am the fourth one in the line. Can you see me?
pages.sourceText: Hello, I am the fourth one in the line. Can you see me?
pages.zh: 你好，我是队伍里的第四只。你能找到我吗？
pages.alt: 你好，我是队伍里的第四只。你能找到我吗？
pages.tip: 慢慢数到第四只，找到了就好。

pages.en: Left, right, left, right. We walk silently in a line.
pages.sourceText: Left, right, left, right. We walk silently in a line.
pages.zh: 左、右、左、右，我们安静地排队走。
pages.alt: 左、右、左、右，我们安静地排队走。
pages.tip: 用两根手指在桌上交替走一走。

pages.en: I just got an idea. I am going to get a set of WHEELS to move faster!
pages.sourceText: I just got an idea. I am going to get a set of WHEELS to move faster!
pages.zh: 我想到啦！我要装一套轮子，让自己走得更快！
pages.alt: 我想到啦！我要装一套轮子，让自己走得更快！
pages.tip: 笑着指出这是蚂蚁的想象，真蚂蚁没有轮子。

pages.en: We are not noisy like other animals. Ours is a language of smells.
pages.sourceText: We are not noisy like other animals. Ours is a language of smells.
pages.zh: 我们不像其他动物那样吵闹，我们用气味交流。
pages.alt: 我们不像其他动物那样吵闹，我们用气味交流。
pages.tip: 用手指描一描蚂蚁走过的路线。

pages.en: One kind of smell says, “Follow me this way for a feast.”
pages.sourceText: One kind of smell says, “Follow me this way for a feast.”
pages.zh: 一种气味说：“跟着我走，这边有大餐。”
pages.alt: 一种气味说：“跟着我走，这边有大餐。”
pages.tip: 找找队伍朝哪边走。

pages.en: Another smell says, “Danger! Do not go there.”
pages.sourceText: Another smell says, “Danger! Do not go there.”
pages.zh: 另一种气味说：“危险！不要去那里。”
pages.alt: 另一种气味说：“危险！不要去那里。”
pages.tip: 找找图中让蚂蚁绕路的地方。

pages.en: I love cakes and all kinds of sweets, just like you.
pages.sourceText: I love cakes and all kinds of sweets, just like you.
pages.zh: 我和你一样，喜欢蛋糕和各种甜食。
pages.alt: 我和你一样，喜欢蛋糕和各种甜食。
pages.tip: 指一指蛋糕，说 cake；不用真的给蚂蚁喂糖。

pages.en: Want to see my muscles at work? I may look very tiny to you, but I am very strong.
pages.sourceText: Want to see my muscles at work? I may look very tiny to you, but I am very strong.
pages.zh: 想看看我的力气吗？我看起来小小的，却很强壮。
pages.alt: 想看看我的力气吗？我看起来小小的，却很强壮。
pages.tip: 找找蚂蚁搬的东西，比比它们的大小。

pages.en: Never mind if the door is shut. I can slip through the smallest crack.
pages.sourceText: Never mind if the door is shut. I can slip through the smallest crack.
pages.zh: 门关了也没关系，我能从最小的缝里钻过去。
pages.alt: 门关了也没关系，我能从最小的缝里钻过去。
pages.tip: 找找门边的小缝。

pages.en: Believe it or not, hundreds of us live happily in a colony.
pages.sourceText: Believe it or not, hundreds of us live happily in a colony.
pages.zh: 信不信由你，我们几百只蚂蚁开心地住在一个群体里。
pages.alt: 信不信由你，我们几百只蚂蚁开心地住在一个群体里。
pages.tip: 看一看图里忙碌的蚂蚁。

pages.en: LET US LEARN SOME NEW WORDS. Small - Big Slow - Fast Short - Tall Thin - Fat Hard - Soft Noisy - Quiet Here are some words with their opposites. Can you make a sentence for each pair of opposite words? For example, ‘An ant is small; an elephant is big’. “As busy as an ant” is a nice way to describe someone who is very hard working.
pages.sourceText: LET US LEARN SOME NEW WORDS. Small - Big Slow - Fast Short - Tall Thin - Fat Hard - Soft Noisy - Quiet Here are some words with their opposites. Can you make a sentence for each pair of opposite words? For example, ‘An ant is small; an elephant is big’. “As busy as an ant” is a nice way to describe someone who is very hard working.
pages.zh: 学几个相反的词：小和大、慢和快、矮和高、瘦和胖、硬和软、吵闹和安静。试着用一组词造句，比如“蚂蚁小，大象大”。“像蚂蚁一样忙碌”用来形容很勤劳的人。
pages.alt: 学几个相反的词：小和大、慢和快、矮和高、瘦和胖、硬和软、吵闹和安静。试着用一组词造句，比如“蚂蚁小，大象大”。“像蚂蚁一样忙碌”用来形容很勤劳的人。
pages.tip: 只挑 small 和 big，比比蚂蚁和大象，不必做完练习。

activity.title: 读完去发现
activity.text: 看一看蚂蚁怎样排队走路，不挡住它们的路。

pages.en: This is my house. Ma, Pa and Cheena also live here.
pages.sourceText: This is my house. Ma, Pa and Cheena also live here.
pages.zh: 这是我的家，爸爸、妈妈和奇娜也住在这里。
pages.alt: 这是我的家，爸爸、妈妈和奇娜也住在这里。
pages.tip: 找找小猫和家里的人。

pages.en: The best chair in the house is for me. But sitting on the lap is even better, isn’t it?
pages.sourceText: The best chair in the house is for me. But sitting on the lap is even better, isn’t it?
pages.zh: 家里最好的椅子归我，不过坐在腿上更舒服，对吧？
pages.alt: 家里最好的椅子归我，不过坐在腿上更舒服，对吧？
pages.tip: 找找小猫坐在哪里。

pages.en: Cheena is my best friend. I wait for her to return from school.
pages.sourceText: Cheena is my best friend. I wait for her to return from school.
pages.zh: 奇娜是我最好的朋友，我等她放学回家。
pages.alt: 奇娜是我最好的朋友，我等她放学回家。
pages.tip: 指指上学的孩子和等候的小猫。

pages.en: I keep myself clean without water. I do not need a bath like Tommy.
pages.sourceText: I keep myself clean without water. I do not need a bath like Tommy.
pages.zh: 我不用水也能把自己弄干净，不像汤米那样要洗澡。
pages.alt: 我不用水也能把自己弄干净，不像汤米那样要洗澡。
pages.tip: 看看小猫怎样舔毛，认识 clean。

pages.en: Shhh... don’t tell anyone that I am hiding here. 1... 2... 3... Got you!
pages.sourceText: Shhh... don’t tell anyone that I am hiding here. 1... 2... 3... Got you!
pages.zh: 嘘，别告诉别人我藏在这里。一、二、三，抓到你啦！
pages.alt: 嘘，别告诉别人我藏在这里。一、二、三，抓到你啦！
pages.tip: 指指藏起来的小猫；这是故事里的捉迷藏。

pages.en: Ma shouts at me, when I bring some tasty food from the garden.
pages.sourceText: Ma shouts at me, when I bring some tasty food from the garden.
pages.zh: 我从花园带回好吃的，妈妈却对我大喊。
pages.alt: 我从花园带回好吃的，妈妈却对我大喊。
pages.tip: 找找妈妈的表情，说说她为什么着急。

pages.en: I can climb trees. I can jump. I know all the short cuts here.
pages.sourceText: I can climb trees. I can jump. I know all the short cuts here.
pages.zh: 我会爬树，也会跳，我知道这里所有的近路。
pages.alt: 我会爬树，也会跳，我知道这里所有的近路。
pages.tip: 用手指沿着小猫的路线走一遍。

pages.en: Sanju lives nearby. He teases me. It makes me very angry.
pages.sourceText: Sanju lives nearby. He teases me. It makes me very angry.
pages.zh: 桑朱住在附近，他逗弄我，让我很生气。
pages.alt: 桑朱住在附近，他逗弄我，让我很生气。
pages.tip: 看看小猫竖起的毛，不去逗弄真的动物。

pages.en: Please tell Sanju that the tiger is from our cat family. We have sharp claws.
pages.sourceText: Please tell Sanju that the tiger is from our cat family. We have sharp claws.
pages.zh: 请告诉桑朱，老虎也属于猫科，我们有锋利的爪子。
pages.alt: 请告诉桑朱，老虎也属于猫科，我们有锋利的爪子。
pages.tip: 比比小猫和老虎的爪子。

pages.en: My friends sometimes make a lot of noise at night. By then I am quietly in bed.
pages.sourceText: My friends sometimes make a lot of noise at night. By then I am quietly in bed.
pages.zh: 朋友们晚上有时很吵，那时我早已安静地躺在床上。
pages.alt: 朋友们晚上有时很吵，那时我早已安静地躺在床上。
pages.tip: 找找已经睡着的小猫。

pages.en: Tails can speak! Did you know how animals and birds tell us something by using their tails? A dog wags its tail when it is happy. A cat puffs up its tail when it is angry. Often we say, “As clean as a cat”. This is because cats do not like water, yet they are always keeping themselves clean by licking themselves.
pages.sourceText: Tails can speak! Did you know how animals and birds tell us something by using their tails? A dog wags its tail when it is happy. A cat puffs up its tail when it is angry. Often we say, “As clean as a cat”. This is because cats do not like water, yet they are always keeping themselves clean by licking themselves.
pages.zh: 尾巴会说话！动物和鸟儿能用尾巴表达什么？狗高兴时摇尾巴，猫生气时尾巴会蓬起来。人们说“像猫一样干净”，因为猫常常舔自己来清洁身体，许多猫也不喜欢水。
pages.alt: 尾巴会说话！动物和鸟儿能用尾巴表达什么？狗高兴时摇尾巴，猫生气时尾巴会蓬起来。人们说“像猫一样干净”，因为猫常常舔自己来清洁身体，许多猫也不喜欢水。
pages.tip: 看图比比两种尾巴；观察动物还要结合耳朵、姿势和当时情境。

activity.title: 读完去发现
activity.text: 观察小猫怎样洗脸；家里没有猫，也可以看图模仿洗脸。

pages.en: I live in the mango tree. I eat lots of ripe fruit in summer.
pages.sourceText: I live in the mango tree. I eat lots of ripe fruit in summer.
pages.zh: 我住在芒果树上，夏天吃很多成熟的水果。
pages.alt: 我住在芒果树上，夏天吃很多成熟的水果。
pages.tip: 在树上找找乌鸦和果实。

pages.en: When my babies are in the nest, I have to be on guard.
pages.sourceText: When my babies are in the nest, I have to be on guard.
pages.zh: 宝宝们在窝里时，我得守护着它们。
pages.alt: 宝宝们在窝里时，我得守护着它们。
pages.tip: 找找鸟妈妈和小鸟。

pages.en: Come peep into my nest. See the lovely things I have found.
pages.sourceText: Come peep into my nest. See the lovely things I have found.
pages.zh: 来看看我的窝，看看我找到的可爱东西。
pages.alt: 来看看我的窝，看看我找到的可爱东西。
pages.tip: 在鸟巢里选一样东西，指给孩子看。

pages.en: I love to fly up in the sky, like a plane.
pages.sourceText: I love to fly up in the sky, like a plane.
pages.zh: 我爱像飞机一样飞上天空。
pages.alt: 我爱像飞机一样飞上天空。
pages.tip: 伸出双臂，轻轻比划飞翔。

pages.en: I sit on the tree and look around for some tasty bits of food.
pages.sourceText: I sit on the tree and look around for some tasty bits of food.
pages.zh: 我坐在树上，四处寻找好吃的。
pages.alt: 我坐在树上，四处寻找好吃的。
pages.tip: 跟着乌鸦的目光找一找。

pages.en: I look to my right. I look to my left.
pages.sourceText: I look to my right. I look to my left.
pages.zh: 我向右看看，再向左看看。
pages.alt: 我向右看看，再向左看看。
pages.tip: 和孩子一起转头，感受 right 和 left。

pages.en: I love fish. When I spot it, I fly down to pick it up.
pages.sourceText: I love fish. When I spot it, I fly down to pick it up.
pages.zh: 我喜欢鱼，看见鱼就飞下去叼起来。
pages.alt: 我喜欢鱼，看见鱼就飞下去叼起来。
pages.tip: 指指乌鸦找到的食物。

pages.en: With my cawing I call my friends to share the feast with me.
pages.sourceText: With my cawing I call my friends to share the feast with me.
pages.zh: 我嘎嘎地叫朋友们来，一起分享大餐。
pages.alt: 我嘎嘎地叫朋友们来，一起分享大餐。
pages.tip: 轻轻模仿一声 caw。

pages.en: Some people shout at me, “Go away, you noisy bird.”
pages.sourceText: Some people shout at me, “Go away, you noisy bird.”
pages.zh: 有些人冲我喊：“走开，你这吵闹的小鸟！”
pages.alt: 有些人冲我喊：“走开，你这吵闹的小鸟！”
pages.tip: 看一看人的动作，不必学着赶鸟。

pages.en: Mr Fox likes my singing. He told me so himself.
pages.sourceText: Mr Fox likes my singing. He told me so himself.
pages.zh: 狐狸先生喜欢我的歌声，他亲口告诉我的。
pages.alt: 狐狸先生喜欢我的歌声，他亲口告诉我的。
pages.tip: 找找狐狸；这是故事中的拟人对话。

pages.en: LET US LEARN SOME NEW WORDS. The sound that each animal or bird makes, has a special name.How many of these do you know? A crow caws. A cat mews.
pages.sourceText: LET US LEARN SOME NEW WORDS. The sound that each animal or bird makes, has a special name.How many of these do you know? A crow caws. A cat mews.
pages.zh: 学几个声音的名字：每种动物或鸟的叫声都有自己的名称。你认识哪些？乌鸦嘎嘎叫，猫喵喵叫。
pages.alt: 学几个声音的名字：每种动物或鸟的叫声都有自己的名称。你认识哪些？乌鸦嘎嘎叫，猫喵喵叫。
pages.tip: 只模仿一种最喜欢的叫声。

pages.en: A lion roars. A dog barks. Crows make a lot of noise. So when some people talk loudly we say, “As noisy as a crow”.
pages.sourceText: A lion roars. A dog barks. Crows make a lot of noise. So when some people talk loudly we say, “As noisy as a crow”.
pages.zh: 狮子吼叫，狗汪汪叫。乌鸦的声音很响，所以人们用“像乌鸦一样吵闹”形容大声说话。
pages.alt: 狮子吼叫，狗汪汪叫。乌鸦的声音很响，所以人们用“像乌鸦一样吵闹”形容大声说话。
pages.tip: 在图中指出狮子和小狗，轻轻学叫就好。

activity.text: 听听附近鸟儿的声音，说一说像哪一种声音。

pages.en: We are a family of four. I follow Chinku everywhere.
pages.sourceText: We are a family of four. I follow Chinku everywhere.
pages.zh: 我们是一家四口，我到哪里都跟着钦库。
pages.alt: 我们是一家四口，我到哪里都跟着钦库。
pages.tip: 找找图里的小狗和孩子。

pages.en: I have to look after Chinku. You see, I am older than him.
pages.sourceText: I have to look after Chinku. You see, I am older than him.
pages.zh: 我得照顾钦库，你看，我比他年纪大。
pages.alt: 我得照顾钦库，你看，我比他年纪大。
pages.tip: 指指陪在孩子身边的小狗。

pages.en: Sometimes Chinku is careless. It is my duty to guard the house.
pages.sourceText: Sometimes Chinku is careless. It is my duty to guard the house.
pages.zh: 有时钦库很粗心，看家就是我的任务。
pages.alt: 有时钦库很粗心，看家就是我的任务。
pages.tip: 找找门边的小狗。

pages.en: We do everything together. We work together.
pages.sourceText: We do everything together. We work together.
pages.zh: 我们什么都一起做，一起干活。
pages.alt: 我们什么都一起做，一起干活。
pages.tip: 指指两位伙伴在做什么。

pages.en: We play together.
pages.sourceText: We play together.
pages.zh: 我们一起玩。
pages.alt: 我们一起玩。
pages.tip: 说 play，再做一个玩球的动作。

pages.en: We even share Ma’s scolding.
pages.sourceText: We even share Ma’s scolding.
pages.zh: 我们连妈妈的批评也一起分担。
pages.alt: 我们连妈妈的批评也一起分担。
pages.tip: 看看两位伙伴的表情。

pages.en: When Chinku is at school I help Ma. I keep the crows away from the papads.
pages.sourceText: When Chinku is at school I help Ma. I keep the crows away from the papads.
pages.zh: 钦库上学时我帮妈妈，把乌鸦从薄饼旁赶走。
pages.alt: 钦库上学时我帮妈妈，把乌鸦从薄饼旁赶走。
pages.tip: 找找屋顶的鸟和晾晒的薄饼。

pages.en: Today Chinku will be my teacher. At last, I will learn something new.
pages.sourceText: Today Chinku will be my teacher. At last, I will learn something new.
pages.zh: 今天钦库要做我的老师，我终于能学点新东西啦。
pages.alt: 今天钦库要做我的老师，我终于能学点新东西啦。
pages.tip: 指一指老师和学生各是谁。

pages.en: I am a good doggy. I do not scare away cats.
pages.sourceText: I am a good doggy. I do not scare away cats.
pages.zh: 我是乖狗狗，不会把猫吓跑。
pages.alt: 我是乖狗狗，不会把猫吓跑。
pages.tip: 找找小猫，练习轻声说 hello。

pages.en: Are you Chinku’s friend? Then you are my friend too.
pages.sourceText: Are you Chinku’s friend? Then you are my friend too.
pages.zh: 你是钦库的朋友吗？那也是我的朋友。
pages.alt: 你是钦库的朋友吗？那也是我的朋友。
pages.tip: 轻轻说 friend，和孩子击个掌。

pages.en: Read the following action sentences. Which of these activities do you like to do? I like dancing. I like swimming. I like skipping. I like drawing.
pages.sourceText: Read the following action sentences. Which of these activities do you like to do? I like dancing. I like swimming. I like skipping. I like drawing.
pages.zh: 读读这些动作句子，你喜欢做哪些？我喜欢跳舞、游泳、跳绳和画画。
pages.alt: 读读这些动作句子，你喜欢做哪些？我喜欢跳舞、游泳、跳绳和画画。
pages.tip: 只挑一个喜欢的动作，说 I like 加原文里的动作。

pages.en: I like cycling. I like climbing. Sometimes we say, “As faithful as a dog”. This is because a dog always stays close to its master. If it goes far away or is lost, a dog always finds its way back home.
pages.sourceText: I like cycling. I like climbing. Sometimes we say, “As faithful as a dog”. This is because a dog always stays close to its master. If it goes far away or is lost, a dog always finds its way back home.
pages.zh: 我喜欢骑车和攀爬。人们说“像狗一样忠诚”，因为狗常常陪伴主人。故事说，狗走远或迷路也能找回家。
pages.alt: 我喜欢骑车和攀爬。人们说“像狗一样忠诚”，因为狗常常陪伴主人。故事说，狗走远或迷路也能找回家。

pages.sourceText: Some wild cats have stripes. Like the tiger!

pages.alt: 有些野生猫科动物身上有条纹，比如老虎！

pages.sourceText: Some wild cats have manes. Like the lion!

pages.alt: 有些爱捕鱼，比如渔猫！

pages.en: Why don’t Bulbuls comb their hair? It looks like a little wave. If I had a Bulbul’s hair, I would wear clips.
pages.sourceText: Why don’t Bulbuls comb their hair? It looks like a little wave. If I had a Bulbul’s hair, I would wear clips.
pages.zh: 鹎为什么不梳头？头顶像一个小波浪。要是我有这样的头发，就戴上发夹。
pages.alt: 鹎为什么不梳头？头顶像一个小波浪。要是我有这样的头发，就戴上发夹。
pages.tip: 指指小波浪；这里的“头发”其实是羽毛。

pages.en: Why don’t Hoopoes comb their hair? It looks like a frilly fan. If I had a Hoopoe's hair, I would push it back with a band.
pages.sourceText: Why don’t Hoopoes comb their hair? It looks like a frilly fan. If I had a Hoopoe's hair, I would push it back with a band.
pages.zh: 戴胜为什么不梳头？头顶像花边扇子。要是我有这样的头发，就用发带往后拢。
pages.alt: 戴胜为什么不梳头？头顶像花边扇子。要是我有这样的头发，就用发带往后拢。
pages.tip: 用手掌张开，比比扇子的样子。

pages.en: Why don't Spoonbills comb their hair? It looks like an old paintbrush. If I had a Spoonbill's hair, I would plait it all together.
pages.sourceText: Why don't Spoonbills comb their hair? It looks like an old paintbrush. If I had a Spoonbill's hair, I would plait it all together.
pages.zh: 琵鹭为什么不梳头？头顶像旧画笔。要是我有这样的头发，就全编成辫子。
pages.alt: 琵鹭为什么不梳头？头顶像旧画笔。要是我有这样的头发，就全编成辫子。
pages.tip: 找找像画笔的羽毛。

pages.en: Why don’t Monals comb their hair? It looks like a tiny broom. If I had a Monal’s hair, I would tie it up with ribbons.
pages.sourceText: Why don’t Monals comb their hair? It looks like a tiny broom. If I had a Monal’s hair, I would tie it up with ribbons.
pages.zh: 虹雉为什么不梳头？头顶像一把小扫帚。要是我有这样的头发，就用丝带扎起来。
pages.alt: 虹雉为什么不梳头？头顶像一把小扫帚。要是我有这样的头发，就用丝带扎起来。
pages.tip: 用手指比比短短的羽冠。

pages.en: Why don't Fish-Owls comb their hair? It looks like two furry worms. If I had a Fish-Owl’s hair, I would make two ponytails.
pages.sourceText: Why don't Fish-Owls comb their hair? It looks like two furry worms. If I had a Fish-Owl’s hair, I would make two ponytails.
pages.zh: 渔鸮为什么不梳头？头顶像两条毛茸茸的虫子。要是我有这样的头发，就扎两个马尾。
pages.alt: 渔鸮为什么不梳头？头顶像两条毛茸茸的虫子。要是我有这样的头发，就扎两个马尾。
pages.tip: 指指头顶毛簇，不把它们当真耳朵。

pages.en: Why don't Drongos comb their hair? It looks like a messy mop. If I had a Drongo’s hair, I would rub oil and brush it down.
pages.sourceText: Why don't Drongos comb their hair? It looks like a messy mop. If I had a Drongo’s hair, I would rub oil and brush it down.
pages.zh: 卷尾为什么不梳头？头顶像乱拖把。要是我有这样的头发，就抹点油梳平。
pages.alt: 卷尾为什么不梳头？头顶像乱拖把。要是我有这样的头发，就抹点油梳平。
pages.tip: 找找长尾巴的鸟，观察头顶。

pages.en: Why don’t Hornbills have hair to comb? They look like they are wearing helmets. If I had a Hornbill’s helmet, I would ride around all day.
pages.sourceText: Why don’t Hornbills have hair to comb? They look like they are wearing helmets. If I had a Hornbill’s helmet, I would ride around all day.
pages.zh: 犀鸟为什么没有头发可梳？它们像戴着头盔。要是我有这样的头盔，就骑车到处玩。
pages.alt: 犀鸟为什么没有头发可梳？它们像戴着头盔。要是我有这样的头盔，就骑车到处玩。
pages.tip: 指指嘴上方像头盔的结构。

pages.en: Why don’t Vultures have any hair? They look so bald. If I had a Vulture’s head, I would never have to comb my hair!
pages.sourceText: Why don’t Vultures have any hair? They look so bald. If I had a Vulture’s head, I would never have to comb my hair!
pages.zh: 秃鹫为什么没有头发？看起来光光的。要是我有这样的头，就不用梳头啦！
pages.alt: 秃鹫为什么没有头发？看起来光光的。要是我有这样的头，就不用梳头啦！
pages.tip: 比比两种不同的鸟头顶。

pages.sourceText: Meet The Birds That Have Funny Hair Common Hoopoe Indian Grey Vulture Himalayan Monal Eurasian Spoonbill
pages.zh: 认识这些发型特别的鸟：戴胜、印度秃鹫、棕尾虹雉和白琵鹭。
pages.alt: 认识这些发型特别的鸟：戴胜、印度秃鹫、棕尾虹雉和白琵鹭。
pages.tip: 只选一种，让孩子在图上找出它。

pages.en: Red-whiskered Bulbul Brown Fish Owl Racket-tailed Drongo Great Indian Hornbill
pages.sourceText: Red-whiskered Bulbul Brown Fish Owl Racket-tailed Drongo Great Indian Hornbill
pages.zh: 红耳鹎、褐渔鸮、大盘尾和双角犀鸟。
pages.alt: 红耳鹎、褐渔鸮、大盘尾和双角犀鸟。
pages.tip: 找找哪一只像戴着头盔。

pages.en: Do birds really have hair? Some birds look like they have hair on their heads. But their hair is not like ours. Instead, each hair is just a very thin feather. A group of such feathers is called a crest. Crests are useful in many ways.They make birds look attractive. Some birds can open and fold their crests to send signals to other birds. Some open their crests when they want to frighten away other birds and animals.
pages.sourceText: Do birds really have hair? Some birds look like they have hair on their heads. But their hair is not like ours. Instead, each hair is just a very thin feather. A group of such feathers is called a crest. Crests are useful in many ways.They make birds look attractive. Some birds can open and fold their crests to send signals to other birds. Some open their crests when they want to frighten away other birds and animals.
pages.zh: 鸟真的有头发吗？有些头顶看起来像头发，其实是细细的羽毛，成簇时叫羽冠。羽冠能让鸟更好看，也能张开或收起传递信号；有些鸟用它吓退其他动物。
pages.alt: 鸟真的有头发吗？有些头顶看起来像头发，其实是细细的羽毛，成簇时叫羽冠。羽冠能让鸟更好看，也能张开或收起传递信号；有些鸟用它吓退其他动物。
pages.tip: 轻轻指一指羽冠，记住 feathers 是羽毛。

pages.en: The furry worms on the owl’s head are called ear-tufts. They are not really ears, just bits of skin covered with feathers. These help owls hide more easily, making them look like they are part of a tree. The ear-tufts also help them look attractive (to other owls) or scary (to other birds and animals). The hornbill’s helmet is called a casque (rhymes with mask). Like ear-tufts and crests, casques make hornbills look good. This helps them find mates. A hornbill’s casque also makes its beak stronger. With a strong beak, hornbills can pick and eat fruits more easily.
pages.sourceText: The furry worms on the owl’s head are called ear-tufts. They are not really ears, just bits of skin covered with feathers. These help owls hide more easily, making them look like they are part of a tree. The ear-tufts also help them look attractive (to other owls) or scary (to other birds and animals). The hornbill’s helmet is called a casque (rhymes with mask). Like ear-tufts and crests, casques make hornbills look good. This helps them find mates. A hornbill’s casque also makes its beak stronger. pages.en: It’s a beautiful and sunny morning at a rocky shore in Mumbai. At low tide, all seems peaceful at a tide pool.
pages.sourceText: It’s a beautiful and sunny morning at a rocky shore in Mumbai. At low tide, all seems peaceful at a tide pool.
pages.zh: 孟买的岩石海岸迎来晴朗的早晨。退潮时，潮池里看上去很平静。
pages.alt: 孟买的岩石海岸迎来晴朗的早晨。退潮时，潮池里看上去很平静。
pages.tip: 找找露出水面的岩石。

pages.en: A pink Porcelain Crab is looking for food. An orange Starfish is moving s-l-o-w-l-y with its tube feet.
pages.sourceText: A pink Porcelain Crab is looking for food. An orange Starfish is moving s-l-o-w-l-y with its tube feet.
pages.zh: 粉红瓷蟹在找食物，橙色海星用管足慢慢移动。
pages.alt: 粉红瓷蟹在找食物，橙色海星用管足慢慢移动。
pages.tip: 分别找出螃蟹和海星。

pages.en: But wait. Is it really peaceful? Oh no! A baby Pufferfish is stuck in the tide pool.
pages.sourceText: But wait. Is it really peaceful? Oh no! A baby Pufferfish is stuck in the tide pool.
pages.zh: 等等，真的平静吗？一只小河豚被困在潮池里了。
pages.alt: 等等，真的平静吗？一只小河豚被困在潮池里了。
pages.tip: 找到小河豚，看看周围的石头。

pages.en: The Pufferfish swims to the left and bumps into a rock. It swims to the right and bumps into a rock. It swims here and there and everywhere, but there seems no way out.
pages.sourceText: The Pufferfish swims to the left and bumps into a rock. It swims to the right and bumps into a rock. It swims here and there and everywhere, but there seems no way out.
pages.zh: 小河豚向左游、向右游，都撞上岩石。它四处游，却找不到出口。
pages.alt: 小河豚向左游、向右游，都撞上岩石。它四处游，却找不到出口。
pages.tip: 用手指跟着它的路线走。

pages.en: “HELP! I am stuck!” cries the Pufferfish. WHOOP! It puffs up to protect itself from danger. It swims around in circles.
pages.sourceText: “HELP! I am stuck!” cries the Pufferfish. WHOOP! It puffs up to protect itself from danger. It swims around in circles.
pages.zh: “救命，我被困住啦！”河豚鼓起身体来保护自己，又转起圈来。
pages.alt: “救命，我被困住啦！”河豚鼓起身体来保护自己，又转起圈来。
pages.tip: 比比鼓起来前后的身体；不模仿屏气。

pages.en: “Don’t panic, little fish,” says the Porcelain Crab. “The tide will come back in,” says the Starfish. But the Pufferfish is too frightened to listen. Round and round it goes.
pages.sourceText: “Don’t panic, little fish,” says the Porcelain Crab. “The tide will come back in,” says the Starfish. But the Pufferfish is too frightened to listen. Round and round it goes.
pages.zh: “别慌，小鱼。”瓷蟹说。“海水会涨回来。”海星说。河豚却怕得听不进去，一直转圈。
pages.alt: “别慌，小鱼。”瓷蟹说。“海水会涨回来。”海星说。河豚却怕得听不进去，一直转圈。
pages.tip: 指指安慰它的两位朋友。

pages.en: “WHO IS MAKING ALL THIS NOISE?” A majestic Octopus swims into the pool from under a rock. The Pufferfish stares in awe.
pages.sourceText: “WHO IS MAKING ALL THIS NOISE?” A majestic Octopus swims into the pool from under a rock. The Pufferfish stares in awe.
pages.zh: “是谁这么吵？”大章鱼从岩石下面游来，小河豚看得惊叹不已。
pages.alt: “是谁这么吵？”大章鱼从岩石下面游来，小河豚看得惊叹不已。
pages.tip: 找找章鱼的腕足。

pages.en: “You feel trapped because the tide is low,” says the Octopus. “When the tide is high, the water will cover all these rocks. And you will be able to swim back home to the sea.”
pages.sourceText: “You feel trapped because the tide is low,” says the Octopus. “When the tide is high, the water will cover all these rocks. And you will be able to swim back home to the sea.”
pages.zh: 章鱼说：“退潮了，你才会觉得被困住。涨潮时海水会漫过岩石，你就能游回大海。”
pages.alt: 章鱼说：“退潮了，你才会觉得被困住。涨潮时海水会漫过岩石，你就能游回大海。”
pages.tip: 比比水位和岩石的位置。

pages.en: The Pufferfish is relieved. It waits. In time, water flows under the Porcelain Crab’s rock. It flows over the Starfish. It flows into the tidepools. The water rises. The Pufferfish rises with it.
pages.sourceText: The Pufferfish is relieved. It waits. In time, water flows under the Porcelain Crab’s rock. It flows over the Starfish. It flows into the tidepools. The water rises. The Pufferfish rises with it.
pages.zh: 河豚放心地等着。水流过瓷蟹的石头和海星，灌进潮池，河豚也随水升高。
pages.alt: 河豚放心地等着。水流过瓷蟹的石头和海星，灌进潮池，河豚也随水升高。
pages.tip: 用手掌慢慢升高，比划涨潮。

pages.en: Finally, the baby Pufferfish can swim over the rocks. It is overjoyed. “Thank you, everyone!” it calls out and swims away into the sea. “Goodbye, little one. Swim safe.”
pages.sourceText: Finally, the baby Pufferfish can swim over the rocks. It is overjoyed. “Thank you, everyone!” it calls out and swims away into the sea. “Goodbye, little one. Swim safe.”
pages.zh: 小河豚终于游过岩石，开心地说“谢谢大家”，游回大海。朋友们说：“再见，小家伙，平安游回去！”
pages.alt: 小河豚终于游过岩石，开心地说“谢谢大家”，游回大海。朋友们说：“再见，小家伙，平安游回去！”
pages.tip: 指指它回家的方向，说 goodbye。

pages.en: What is a tide pool? Tide pools are shallow pools of seawater on rocky shores. You find these at low tide when the rest of the water has flowed back into the sea. Tidepools are in the intertidal zone, the part of the beach only seen at low tide. Low tide is when the water flows back far into the sea. High tide is when the water covers most of the shore. Tides are caused by the gravitational pull of the Moon on the Earth. Low Tide, High Tide
pages.sourceText: What is a tide pool? Tide pools are shallow pools of seawater on rocky shores. You find these at low tide when the rest of the water has flowed back into the sea. Tidepools are in the intertidal zone, the part of the beach only seen at low tide. Low tide is when the water flows back far into the sea. High tide is when the water covers most of the shore. Tides are caused by the gravitational pull of the Moon on the Earth. Low Tide, High Tide
pages.zh: 潮池是岩石海岸上浅浅的海水池，退潮后才露出来，位于潮间带。退潮时水退向大海，涨潮时水盖住大部分海岸，潮汐与月球对地球的引力有关。
pages.alt: 潮池是岩石海岸上浅浅的海水池，退潮后才露出来，位于潮间带。退潮时水退向大海，涨潮时水盖住大部分海岸，潮汐与月球对地球的引力有关。
pages.tip: 只看图比较 low tide 和 high tide，不必背解释。

pages.en: Meet Loten. He is a long-billed sunbird. His feathers are purple and maroon. The yellow and grey bird is his sister, Lily.
pages.sourceText: Meet Loten. He is a long-billed sunbird. His feathers are purple and maroon. The yellow and grey bird is his sister, Lily.
pages.zh: 认识一下长嘴太阳鸟洛滕，他的羽毛是紫色和栗色。黄灰色的是妹妹莉莉。
pages.alt: 认识一下长嘴太阳鸟洛滕，他的羽毛是紫色和栗色。黄灰色的是妹妹莉莉。
pages.tip: 在图里分别找到两只鸟。

pages.en: Sunbirds like Loten and Lily live in parts of India and Sri Lanka. They are as long as a 100-rupee note and weigh as much as a ten-rupee coin. 15cm 14cm
pages.sourceText: Sunbirds like Loten and Lily live in parts of India and Sri Lanka. They are as long as a 100-rupee note and weigh as much as a ten-rupee coin. 15cm 14cm
pages.zh: 这样的太阳鸟生活在印度和斯里兰卡部分地区，长度像一张100卢比纸币，重量像一枚10卢比硬币。
pages.alt: 这样的太阳鸟生活在印度和斯里兰卡部分地区，长度像一张100卢比纸币，重量像一枚10卢比硬币。
pages.tip: 用图中的尺子感受它们身体很小。

pages.en: Loten and Lily have curved beaks and tube-shaped tongues to gather nectar from flowers.
pages.sourceText: Loten and Lily have curved beaks and tube-shaped tongues to gather nectar from flowers.
pages.zh: 弯曲的鸟喙和管状舌头帮助它们从花里采花蜜。
pages.alt: 弯曲的鸟喙和管状舌头帮助它们从花里采花蜜。
pages.tip: 用手指沿着鸟喙的弯曲描一描。

pages.en: When Loten and Lily were babies, they had short, wide beaks so that their parents could feed them easily. Their parents digested the food a little in their stomachs before feeding it to them.
pages.sourceText: When Loten and Lily were babies, they had short, wide beaks so that their parents could feed them easily. Their parents digested the food a little in their stomachs before feeding it to them.
pages.zh: 小时候，它们的嘴短而宽，方便父母喂食。父母会先在胃里稍作消化，再喂给宝宝。
pages.alt: 小时候，它们的嘴短而宽，方便父母喂食。父母会先在胃里稍作消化，再喂给宝宝。
pages.tip: 找找张嘴的小鸟和喂食的亲鸟。

pages.en: When they grew strong enough, Loten and Lily learnt to fly. They also had to learn to find their own food.
pages.sourceText: When they grew strong enough, Loten and Lily learnt to fly. They also had to learn to find their own food.
pages.zh: 长得强壮后，它们学会了飞，也要学会自己找食物。
pages.alt: 长得强壮后，它们学会了飞，也要学会自己找食物。
pages.tip: 指指离开树枝的小鸟。

pages.en: Loten and Lily get energy from what they eat and drink. This energy allows them to use their muscles to fly.
pages.sourceText: Loten and Lily get energy from what they eat and drink. This energy allows them to use their muscles to fly.
pages.zh: 吃喝带来的能量，让它们能用肌肉飞翔。
pages.alt: 吃喝带来的能量，让它们能用肌肉飞翔。
pages.tip: 轻轻扇动手臂，感受飞翔要用力。

pages.en: Unlike us humans, Loten and Lily cannot store much energy in their bodies as fat. They have to stay very light. Otherwise, they will not be able to fly.
pages.sourceText: Unlike us humans, Loten and Lily cannot store much energy in their bodies as fat. They have to stay very light. Otherwise, they will not be able to fly.
pages.zh: 它们不像人类那样能在身体里储存很多脂肪，必须保持轻盈才能飞。
pages.alt: 它们不像人类那样能在身体里储存很多脂肪，必须保持轻盈才能飞。
pages.tip: 观察小小的身体和张开的翅膀，不必背术语。

pages.en: This is why sunbirds have to eat many times a day. In fact, they spend most of their days flying around, looking for food.
pages.sourceText: This is why sunbirds have to eat many times a day. In fact, they spend most of their days flying around, looking for food.
pages.zh: 所以太阳鸟一天要吃很多次，大部分时间都飞来飞去找食物。
pages.alt: 所以太阳鸟一天要吃很多次，大部分时间都飞来飞去找食物。
pages.tip: 沿着虚线跟踪它们的路线。

pages.en: Loten and Lily drink nectar from flowers. They also like to eat insects and spiders. Sometimes, they eat small, juicy fruit.
pages.sourceText: Loten and Lily drink nectar from flowers. They also like to eat insects and spiders. Sometimes, they eat small, juicy fruit.
pages.zh: 它们喝花蜜，也吃昆虫、蜘蛛，有时吃小巧多汁的水果。
pages.alt: 它们喝花蜜，也吃昆虫、蜘蛛，有时吃小巧多汁的水果。
pages.tip: 在图里找出一种食物。

pages.en: If you spot a bird like Loten or Lily in a garden or a park, take a peek at what they are eating!
pages.sourceText: If you spot a bird like Loten or Lily in a garden or a park, take a peek at what they are eating!
pages.zh: 如果在公园或花园看见这样的鸟，就悄悄看看它们在吃什么吧！
pages.alt: 如果在公园或花园看见这样的鸟，就悄悄看看它们在吃什么吧！
pages.tip: 说一说要远远观察、不打扰。

pages.en: Where Does Energy Come From? Energy comes from food. Animals, including humans and birds, need energy to stay alive. It allows our bodies to work and our brains to think. Some birds have to eat every two hours, otherwise they wouldn’t have enough energy to stay alive. Bigger animals, like adult humans, can survive about two months without any food, if they really have to. But to live well, we need to eat many times a day!
pages.sourceText: Where Does Energy Come From? Energy comes from food. Animals, including humans and birds, need energy to stay alive. It allows our bodies to work and our brains to think. Some birds have to eat every two hours, otherwise they wouldn’t have enough energy to stay alive. Bigger animals, like adult humans, can survive about two months without any food, if they really have to. But to live well, we need to eat many times a day!
pages.zh: 能量从食物中来，让包括人和鸟在内的动物维持生命、活动和思考。有些鸟每两小时就要吃东西。原文也比较了较大动物在极端情况下的耐饥时间；为了健康，我们每天都应规律进食。
pages.alt: 能量从食物中来，让包括人和鸟在内的动物维持生命、活动和思考。有些鸟每两小时就要吃东西。原文也比较了较大动物在极端情况下的耐饥时间；为了健康，我们每天都应规律进食。
pages.tip: 只理解“食物提供能量”，不尝试挨饿或比较耐饥。

pages.zh: 这一页没有文字。
pages.alt: 这一页没有文字。
pages.tip: 找找鸟喙旁的花朵，回想 nectar。

activity.title: 读完去发现
activity.text: 在花园远远观察鸟儿是否到花朵旁觅食，不投喂。

pages.en: Who just went by?
pages.sourceText: Who just went by?
pages.zh: 谁刚刚走过？
pages.alt: 谁刚刚走过？
pages.tip: 看看泥地脚印，先猜一猜。

pages.en: The tiger chasing the spotted deer.
pages.sourceText: The tiger chasing the spotted deer.
pages.zh: 追着梅花鹿的老虎。
pages.alt: 追着梅花鹿的老虎。
pages.tip: 比较两种脚印的形状，不模仿追逐。

pages.en: Who just went by?
pages.sourceText: Who just went by?
pages.zh: 谁刚刚走过？
pages.alt: 谁刚刚走过？
pages.tip: 找找沙滩上的细小痕迹。

pages.en: The sandpiper chasing the ghost crab.
pages.sourceText: The sandpiper chasing the ghost crab.
pages.zh: 追着沙蟹的鹬。
pages.alt: 追着沙蟹的鹬。
pages.tip: 分别指出鸟和螃蟹的足迹。

pages.en: Who just went by?
pages.sourceText: Who just went by?
pages.zh: 谁刚刚走过？
pages.alt: 谁刚刚走过？
pages.tip: 在雪地里找两种脚印。

pages.en: The snow leopard chasing the blue sheep.
pages.sourceText: The snow leopard chasing the blue sheep.
pages.zh: 追着岩羊的雪豹。
pages.alt: 追着岩羊的雪豹。
pages.tip: 看看猫科动物和蹄子留下的不同印记。

pages.en: Who just went by?
pages.sourceText: Who just went by?
pages.zh: 谁刚刚走过？
pages.alt: 谁刚刚走过？
pages.tip: 沿着沙上的痕迹往前找。

pages.en: The fox chasing the agama.
pages.sourceText: The fox chasing the agama.
pages.zh: 追着飞蜥的狐狸。
pages.alt: 追着飞蜥的狐狸。
pages.tip: 找找小蜥蜴尾巴拖出的细线。

pages.en: Who just went by?
pages.sourceText: Who just went by?
pages.zh: 谁刚刚走过？
pages.alt: 谁刚刚走过？
pages.tip: 比较脚掌印和细细的痕迹。

pages.en: The cat chasing the slug.
pages.sourceText: The cat chasing the slug.
pages.zh: 追着蛞蝓的小猫。
pages.alt: 追着蛞蝓的小猫。
pages.tip: 指指猫爪印，再找找蛞蝓的路线。

pages.en: Who just went by?
pages.sourceText: Who just went by?
pages.zh: 谁刚刚走过？
pages.alt: 谁刚刚走过？
pages.tip: 看看湿地上的两条不同路线。

pages.en: The snail and the crab walking together. They are best friends!
pages.sourceText: The snail and the crab walking together. They are best friends!
pages.zh: 一起走路的蜗牛和螃蟹，它们是好朋友！
pages.alt: 一起走路的蜗牛和螃蟹，它们是好朋友！
pages.tip: 指出这是拟人结尾，比较两种移动痕迹。

pages.en: Watch Where You Walk The study of footprints is very interesting. - Scientists have found marks of creatures that lived on Earth more than 500 million years ago. - People who hunt and gather food from the forest know how to read animal tracks. - Members of a community called the Irulas in South India can tell the exact name of the snake simply by seeing its marks on the ground. - The next time you go to a forest, ask your guide to show you animal tracks.
pages.sourceText: Watch Where You Walk The study of footprints is very interesting. - Scientists have found marks of creatures that lived on Earth more than 500 million years ago. - People who hunt and gather food from the forest know how to read animal tracks. - Members of a community called the Irulas in South India can tell the exact name of the snake simply by seeing its marks on the ground. - The next time you go to a forest, ask your guide to show you animal tracks.
pages.zh: 留意脚下：足迹研究很有趣。科学家发现过五亿多年前生物留下的痕迹；森林里的采集者懂得辨认足迹；印度南部伊鲁拉人能从地面痕迹认出蛇。下次去森林，可以请向导指认足迹。
pages.alt: 留意脚下：足迹研究很有趣。科学家发现过五亿多年前生物留下的痕迹；森林里的采集者懂得辨认足迹；印度南部伊鲁拉人能从地面痕迹认出蛇。下次去森林，可以请向导指认足迹。
pages.tip: 只选图中的一种印记比较，不自行追踪野生动物。

activity.text: 雨后看看地上的脚印，猜猜是谁留下的，只观察安全的地方。

pages.en: The ladybird is an insect with lots of black spots. Many, many black spots.
pages.sourceText: The ladybird is an insect with lots of black spots. Many, many black spots.
pages.zh: 瓢虫是一种身上有很多很多黑色斑点的昆虫。
pages.alt: 瓢虫是一种身上有很多很多黑色斑点的昆虫。
pages.tip: 找三处黑斑点，听 spots。

pages.en: It's not a butterfly. It's a different insect.
pages.sourceText: It's not a butterfly. It's a different insect.
pages.zh: 它不是蝴蝶，是另一种昆虫。
pages.alt: 它不是蝴蝶，是另一种昆虫。
pages.tip: 分别指指蝴蝶和瓢虫。

pages.en: It's not an insect with flat wings. It's an insect with round wings.
pages.sourceText: It's not an insect with flat wings. It's an insect with round wings.
pages.zh: 它不是翅膀扁平的那种昆虫，它有圆圆的翅膀。
pages.alt: 它不是翅膀扁平的那种昆虫，它有圆圆的翅膀。
pages.tip: 看红色圆壳；那是鞘翅，下面还藏着飞行用的翅膀。

pages.en: It's not a big insect. It's a small insect.
pages.sourceText: It's not a big insect. It's a small insect.
pages.zh: 它不是大昆虫，而是小昆虫。
pages.alt: 它不是大昆虫，而是小昆虫。
pages.tip: 用手指比一个小小的距离，说 small。

pages.en: It has spots which are equal in shape and size. It has a red body with black spots.
pages.sourceText: It has spots which are equal in shape and size. It has a red body with black spots.
pages.zh: 斑点形状、大小相似，它有红色身体和黑色斑点。
pages.alt: 斑点形状、大小相似，它有红色身体和黑色斑点。
pages.tip: 指着黑色和红色分别找一找；不同瓢虫花纹不都一样。

pages.en: Ladybird, how did you get spots all over your body?
pages.sourceText: Ladybird, how did you get spots all over your body?
pages.zh: 瓢虫，你怎么全身都有斑点？
pages.alt: 瓢虫，你怎么全身都有斑点？
pages.tip: 看看孩子的好奇表情。

pages.en: Did you get them yourself?
pages.sourceText: Did you get them yourself?
pages.zh: 是你自己弄上去的吗？
pages.alt: 是你自己弄上去的吗？
pages.tip: 和孩子猜一猜，斑点本来就长在身上。

pages.en: Can you give me one?
pages.sourceText: Can you give me one?
pages.zh: 你能送给我一个吗？
pages.alt: 你能送给我一个吗？
pages.tip: 轻轻说一个斑点不能真的摘下来。

pages.en: I want a spot.
pages.sourceText: I want a spot.
pages.zh: 我想要一个斑点。
pages.alt: 我想要一个斑点。
pages.tip: 用手在纸上画一个小圆。

pages.en: Not many spots, just one.
pages.sourceText: Not many spots, just one.
pages.zh: 不要很多，只要一个。
pages.alt: 不要很多，只要一个。
pages.tip: 举起一根手指，说 one。

pages.en: One red spot to put on my forehead to be like a ladybird.
pages.sourceText: One red spot to put on my forehead to be like a ladybird.
pages.zh: 一枚红点放在额头，就像一只小瓢虫。
pages.alt: 一枚红点放在额头，就像一只小瓢虫。
pages.tip: 指指小女孩额头的红点。

pages.en: Match the following : Lady bird Butterfly Flat winged insect Black spot Red spot
pages.sourceText: Match the following : Lady bird Butterfly Flat winged insect Black spot Red spot
pages.zh: 连一连：瓢虫、蝴蝶、平翅昆虫、黑斑点和红斑点。
pages.alt: 连一连：瓢虫、蝴蝶、平翅昆虫、黑斑点和红斑点。
pages.tip: 不用做练习，只让孩子指出一只瓢虫。

activity.title: 读完去发现
activity.text: 找一个圆形贴纸画出瓢虫斑点，数一数、说一说颜色。
